rule.statement: A settlement or compromise must be notified to the Court by motion and must strictly conform to the provisions of Section 91 and Section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rule.supporting_quote: In the case of Gunawardena v. Ran Menike and Others [2002] 3 Sri L.R 243 it was held that where there has been a settlement or compromise it must be in strict compliance with the provisions of Section 91 and Section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 91 and Section 408 of the Civil Procedure Code
